title: Argentinian Haddock Gratin
description: A simple, flavorful dish from Argentina, featuring pan-seared haddock topped with a creamy gratin.
instructions: Season the haddock fillets with salt and pepper.
Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in an oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the haddock fillets and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, until browned.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 8-10 minutes, until cooked through.
While the haddock is baking, mix the diced tomatoes, onion, garlic, and lemon juice in a bowl.
Stir in the grated parmesan cheese.
Remove the skillet from the oven and top each haddock fillet with the tomato mixture.
Return the skillet to the oven and bake for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the top is golden brown.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped parsley if desired.
